title: Rabbit Chase
shortDescription: Catch the rabbit, collect coins, and beat your best!
fullDescription:
The rabbit is quick. Are your reflexes quicker?

Catch the hopping rabbit before it escapes, earn coins, and level up through increasingly challenging rounds. Build catch combos, unlock customizations, collect power-ups, and see how high you can score.

FEATURES
• Fast, touch-friendly 30-second rounds
• Hopping rabbit with increasing difficulty
• Coins, streaks, combos, and unlockable customizations
• Personal best and game progress saved on your device
• Play offline after installation

Rabbit Chase is a casual single-player mini game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Counter-Strike or Valve.
